description: Chat and agent workspace running a local model on your own NVIDIA GPU.
notes: Simplex needs Python 3.11+ and an NVIDIA GPU with a current driver.
Run 'simplex' (or start.bat) once to set up: it picks a model size that
fits the card, installs into its own folder and downloads the weights.
Weights and the virtualenv live in the persist folder, so they survive updates.
